issue.title: sase repo open mis-resolves primary_dir/workspace for auto_clone linked repos (sase-core)
issue.description:
Reproduction (from workspace sase_11, host project gh_sase-org__sase, cwd = the
workspace root):

  $ sase repo open sase-core -r "..."
  Current directory belongs to a different project's workspace; pass -w/--workspace.

cwd IS that project's workspace 11, so this message is wrong on its face.

  $ sase repo open sase-core -r "..." -w 11
  Primary workspace directory does not exist: /home/bryan/projects/git/sase-core

  $ sase repo open sase-core -r "..." -p gh_sase-org__sase -w 11
  Primary workspace directory does not exist: /home/bryan/projects/git/sase-core

But the agent process's own SASE_LINKED_REPOS_JSON env var reports, for the same
linked repo entry (name: sase-core, auto_clone: true):
  primary_dir: /home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core
  workspace_dir: /home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_11/sase/repos/linked/sase-core

i.e. github (with the sase-org segment), not git. The CLI's own computed
primary_dir ("/home/bryan/projects/git/sase-core") disagrees with the env-exported
value, and is also missing the org path segment. This matches the resolution
described in the closed bead sase-in, which confirms
SASE_LINKED_REPO_SASE_CORE_PRIMARY_DIR=/home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core
is the authoritative primary dir - sase-in's fix was scoped to the Justfile's
sase_core_dir recipe var, not to `sase repo open`'s own resolution, so this
appears to be an unfixed sibling bug in a different code path.

Impact: the auditable `sase repo open` entry point cannot be used for this linked
repo from this workspace at all - every invocation errors before doing anything.
It does not block actual repo access: the workspace_dir
(.../sase_11/sase/repos/linked/sase-core) is already a valid, up-to-date,
auto-cloned checkout on disk (confirmed via `git status` / `git log` inside it),
so an agent can just use that path directly, but that skips the `sase repo log`
audit trail the skill relies on.

Discovered while implementing sase/repos/plans/202608/sase_core_ci_parity_gate.md
in workspace sase_11 on 2026-08-12.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-in — closed bead that fixed the same primary_dir/workspace-dir ambient-env-var confusion for sase-core, but scoped to the Justfile's sase_core_dir recipe variable. Confirms SASE_LINKED_REPO_SASE_CORE_PRIMARY_DIR=/home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core is authoritative; this bead is about sase repo open's own (different) resolution path still getting it wrong.
